name: In the Mud
description: Five female prisoners forge a unique bond after a deadly accident... until corruption and turf wars within a ruthless prison threaten to destroy them.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A prison transport is hijacked, freeing one female convict and cementing the fates of six others. Prison politics get heated between competing factions.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: María makes Gladys an offer and attacks La Zurda with long-lasting consequences. Marina receives news regarding her release. A prison birth goes wrong.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Moranzón cracks down on the inmates. Marina enters La Zurda's den. María calls Gladys. La Gallega gets a special surprise — and a devastating one.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Brisa wins Eugenia's favor. Marina's court hearing goes awry. La Zurda takes La Gallega under her wing. Antín makes Gladys a life-changing offer.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: For Marina, everything comes with strings attached. La Gallega suffers a loss, and Yael lets Brisa spend time with Eugenia. María is betrayed.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Faccia blackmails Moranzón in exchange for Brisa. María's death shakes up the prison's hierarchy. Gladys and Yael grow closer. Noelia gives birth.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Moranzón's past is explored, and Alan saves Marina from a visitor. Gladys gives Antín intel on Moranzón's illicit dealings. Yael's fate is in limbo.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Lunati enlists the help of an old friend for Marina's case. Moranzón's empire crumbles. La Gallega's revenge comes for Gladys — but at what cost?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The inmates of La Quebrada must survive under a new warden and a new gang led by a vicious prisoner. A betrayal lands La Borges in an epic dilemma.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A personal hit forces La Borges to strike a difficult deal. Nicole's rebellion turns drastic. A murder puts every inmate under the microscope.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: An eye for an eye takes on a new meaning with La Borges at the helm. A heartbroken Yael makes an extreme decision. A series of favors is exchanged.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Nieves joins Las Pendejas as La Gringa cuts La Zurda's business. Nicole leaves Julián with an opening. Cachete pushes Roqui to the edge of madness.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Nicole's proximity to Julián offers a new avenue of opportunity. Out for blood, La Zurda's revenge hones in on La Gringa. Antín blackmails Roberto.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: María Elena's crime comes to light as La Gringa's hold on La Quebrada weakens. La Zurda recruits Lalo to help La Borges. Nicole falls for Julián's trap.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: La Gringa discovers Nicole's betrayal and recruits Yael for her own means. Antín plans what to do with Julián, as La Borges calls in a favor from Miguel.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: La Zurda launches a war against La Gringa. Solita and Nicole make their next move. As Antín's plans fall into place, will La Borges survive?
